name: Gretna Green

outdoor.description: Grass lawn and picnic tables by the coach park (right of building)

notes: Single site between junctions accessible from both carriageways. Little Waitrose shop; Costa is Costa Express on the MFG/BP forecourt. Also The Good Breakfast, Canny Scot Shop. EV: Applegreen, GRIDSERVE, Tesla, IONITY.
uncertain: No dog walking area mentioned (not confirmed absent).

name: Annandale Water

outdoor.description: Lake behind the building with a walk around it (resident geese) and a large field at the far end of the car park

notes: Off-junction site at J16 (Johnstonebridge) serving both directions. M&S Simply Food and Wild Bean Cafe are on the BP forecourt. GRIDSERVE HPC chargers.
uncertain: No explicit dog walking area mentioned, though the lake walk is suitable. Picnic tables not confirmed.

name: Cairn Lodge

outdoor.description: Small grass area at front of building, public footpath connection, children's play area

notes: Westmorland (Tebay/Gloucester family) site since 2014, near Happendon/Douglas. Kitchen cafe, farm shop (new shop opened 21 June 2024), cheese and gelato counters. Shell forecourt. Westmorland Charging 150kW. No hotel.
uncertain: Junction reported by motorwayservices.uk as 'M74 at J11 and J12' (accessible from A70/B7078); no Wikipedia article found, coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page (55.583245,-3.822346), consistent with the site's location. No dog area mentioned.

name: Abington

uncertain: Hotel: amenities list says Days Inn but history says it opened as a Travelodge; Days Inn assumed current. No picnic or dog area mentioned.

name: Hamilton

Starbucks is Starbucks on the Go on the Esso/ASDA Express forecourt. Costa Drive Thru. GRIDSERVE HPC chargers.

uncertain: Facilities are not itemised per side; both sides assumed to have M&S Food and Wild Bean Cafe based on the 2021 refurbishment text. Per-side coordinates not available. No dog area mentioned.
